fluff.overview: Clan foot Points are the smallest standard Clan infantry formation, fielding five dismounted warriors in a single tactical element. Within the Clan Touman, foot Points draw from freeborn warriors or aging solahma assigned to garrison duties beneath the notice of front-line Clusters. These troops hold secondary objectives, secure supply caches, and perform the unglamorous security work that frees OmniMech Stars for combat. The Clan warrior caste views conventional infantry as a necessary burden rather than a point of pride, but garrison commanders rely on foot Points to maintain territorial control across occupied worlds.
